Audit a statistical estimator via Monte Carlo calibration and fuzzing

Source: R/audit-estimator.R
audit_estimator.Rd

Evaluates parameter recovery (bias, RMSE, empirical vs. model SE ratio, and confidence-interval coverage with exact Clopper-Pearson bounds accounting for Monte Carlo error), Type-I error calibration under a null DGP, non-convergence and singular-fit rates, and optionally Simulation-Based Calibration (audit_sbc()) and parallel RNG invariance (check_parallel_rng()).

Usage

audit_estimator(
  dgp,
  estimator,
  true_params = NULL,
  n_sim = 200L,
  alpha = 0.05,
  null_dgp = NULL,
  null_params = NULL,
  n_sim_null = n_sim,
  sbc_prior = NULL,
  sbc_dgp = NULL,
  sbc_draws = NULL,
  sbc_n_sim = 100L,
  sbc_bins = 10L,
  check_parallel = FALSE,
  parallel_runner = NULL,
  parallel_cores = c(1L, 2L),
  parallel_n_sim = 8L,
  seed = 42L,
  mc_alpha = 0.01,
  bias_tol_mc = 3,
  se_ratio_bounds = c(0.85, 1.15),
  max_fail_rate = 0.05,
  warn_fail_rate = 0.01,
  max_singular_rate = 0.1
)

Arguments

dgp

Data-generating function. Either function() (0 arguments) or function(true_params) receiving true_params.

estimator

Fitting function function(data) returning either:

  • A named list with estimate (required) and optional se, ci_lower, ci_upper, p_value, converged, singular;

  • A fitted lm, glm, lmerMod, glmerMod, or htest object; or

  • A numeric vector of point estimates.

true_params

Named numeric vector (or scalar) of ground-truth parameter values matching names returned by estimator. If unnamed, names are matched positionally to the estimator output.

n_sim

Integer number of Monte Carlo replications (default 200L).

alpha

Nominal significance level for confidence intervals (1 - alpha) and Type-I error checks (default 0.05).

null_dgp

Optional null data-generating function for dedicated Type-I error calibration. If NULL, any parameters in true_params equal to 0 are automatically audited for Type-I error.

null_params

Optional character vector of parameter names to evaluate under null_dgp (defaults to all parameters returned by estimator).

n_sim_null

Integer number of replications for null_dgp (defaults to n_sim).

sbc_prior

Optional prior sampler for Simulation-Based Calibration (forwarded to audit_sbc()).

sbc_dgp

Optional likelihood simulator function(theta) for SBC (defaults to dgp).

sbc_draws

Optional posterior draw function function(data) for SBC.

sbc_n_sim

Integer SBC replications (default 100L).

sbc_bins

Integer SBC histogram bins (default 10L).

check_parallel

Logical; if TRUE, also runs check_parallel_rng() to verify parallel RNG invariance. Default FALSE.

parallel_runner

Optional custom function(cores, seed) for check_parallel_rng(). If NULL and check_parallel = TRUE, automatically tests dgp + estimator through statci_parallel_apply().

parallel_cores

Integer vector of core counts to compare (default c(1L, 2L)).

parallel_n_sim

Number of tasks used in parallel invariance check (default 8L).

seed

Integer RNG seed (default 42L).

mc_alpha

Exact binomial / Monte Carlo failure significance threshold (default 0.01).

bias_tol_mc

Monte Carlo z-score threshold (|bias| / MCSE_bias) for failing bias recovery (default 3.0).

se_ratio_bounds

Numeric length-2 target range for mean(model_SE) / empirical_SE (default c(0.85, 1.15)).

max_fail_rate

Maximum tolerable error/non-convergence rate before "fail" (default 0.05).

warn_fail_rate

Error/non-convergence rate threshold for "warn" (default 0.01).

max_singular_rate

Maximum tolerable singular-fit rate before "fail" (default 0.10).

Value

An S3 object of class "statci_estimator_audit" containing recovery, type1, convergence, sbc, parallel_rng, settings, and overall status ("pass", "warn", or "fail").

Examples

res <- audit_estimator(
  dgp = function() {
    x <- rnorm(80)
    data.frame(x = x, y = 0.5 * x + rnorm(80))
  },
  estimator = function(df) lm(y ~ x, data = df),
  true_params = c(x = 0.5),
  n_sim = 60L,
  seed = 42L
)
res
#> [PASS] statci Estimator Audit (n_sim = 60, valid = 60, fail_rate = 0.0%,
#> singular_rate = 0.0%)
#> Parameter Recovery:
#> [PASS] x: bias = 0.0057 (z = 0.36), RMSE = 0.1214, SE ratio = 0.930, coverage =
#> 93.3%
